Weiter mithören

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Weiter mithören?

In this glossary, Weiter mithören refers to: Instruction to keep monitoring a specified VHF radio channel or other communication line for further traffic or safety messages.

How is Weiter mithören used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Fahrzeug Tango, derzeit keine weiteren Anweisungen. Weiter mithören auf UKW-Kanal sechzehn für Updates."

Why does Weiter mithören matter in maritime?

Weiter mithören matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Weiter mithören?

Weiter mithören is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

Instruction to keep monitoring a specified VHF radio channel or other communication line for further traffic or safety messages.

Operational example

Vessel Tango, no further instructions at this time. Continue listening on VHF channel one-six for updates.

Localized term

Weiter mithören

Localized example

Fahrzeug Tango, derzeit keine weiteren Anweisungen. Weiter mithören auf UKW-Kanal sechzehn für Updates.
